name: Access rights
description: Whether the data itself, not just its listing, is available. Publishing details about restricted data is fine. Not saying it's restricted is not.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Restricted
hasDefinedTerm.description: Anyone can see the listing, but getting the data itself needs permission.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Non-public
hasDefinedTerm.description: Only the publishing body can access the data.
